rows.ja: 決済ネットワーク・流通

relations.text: Cash App CardはVisaカードが使える場所で利用できると説明している
relations.text_en: Block says Cash App funds can be spent anywhere that accepts Visa cards

source.label: Block 10-K
source.quote: These funds can then be sent to another customer through the app, spent anywhere that accepts Visa cards or Cash App Pay, withdrawn from an ATM using the Cash App Card, invested in stocks or exchange-traded funds (“ETFs”), used to buy bitcoin, or transferred to a bank account (either instantly for a fee or for free in one to three days).

relations.text: Cash App Cardは、Visaカードが使えるどこでも買い物に使える
relations.text_en: Customers can use the Cash App Card anywhere that accepts Visa cards

source.label: Block 10-K
source.quote: Customers can order a Cash App Card for free and use it anywhere that accepts Visa cards to make purchases, drawing down from the funds stored in their Cash App balance.

companies.name: Apple
companies.sub: スマートフォン・ソフト

relations.text: 年次報告で、Appleなどのアプリ配信市場の運営者が行う変更が、Blockの製品へのアクセスを難しくし得ると述べている
relations.text_en: The 10-K says changes by Apple, Google, or other app marketplace operators may make access to Block's products and services more difficult

source.label: Block 10-K
source.quote: Apple, Google, or other operators of app marketplaces regularly make changes to their marketplaces, and those changes may make access to our products and services more difficult.
source.note: 配信市場の運営者としての記載です。
source.note_en: Listed as an app marketplace operator.

relations.text: Appleなどが提供するソフト更新が、Blockの製品でうまく動作しない可能性があると述べている
relations.text_en: Software updates from Apple, Google, or others may not operate effectively with Block's products and services

source.label: Block 10-K
source.quote: Furthermore, Apple, Google, or other operators of app marketplaces regularly provide software updates, and such software updates may not operate effectively with our products and services, which may reduce the demand for our products and services, result in dissatisfaction by our customers, and may materially and adversely affect our business.
